3.5.2.3 TDEventCom
[TPS_TIMEX_00021] Purpose of TDEventCom ⌈The element TDEventCom and its
specializations are used to describe the occurrences of an event which are observed
at a specific location in the System view, in particular any event related to communica-
tions.⌋(RS_TIMEX_00001)
Events related to communication can be used during the specification of:
• SystemTiming 3.1.2
• EcuTiming 3.1.5
